event.text:
Confirmed this is the pre-existing worker-starvation flake that `vitest.config.mts` already documents and mitigates (`isolate: false`, with a comment describing exactly this failure signature — `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'config')` / `Vitest failed to find the runner` — as random spawn-storm failures with no code fault). None of the failing files belong to either task on this board's file lists (`model-profile.test.ts`, `phase-choices.test.ts`, `plan-bar.test.ts`, `chat-tabs.test.ts`, `plan-state-fixture.ts`, `chat-transcript.test.ts`, `chat-composer.test.ts`, `session-manager.test.ts`, `session-status.test.ts`); the failures were in unrelated files (task-board-tools, tasks-file, tool-server, tools, test-outline, unfiled-decisions, unified-diff, unit-size, user-question, verification, webview-font-size).

I reran `npm test` twice more with no code changes: both runs passed clean (96 passed, 2 skipped / 1188 tests passed, 3 skipped — no failures). Since the failure doesn't reproduce and doesn't touch either task's files, there is nothing to fix and no task to move; both tasks stay `tested` as they already were.
